hasDerivAt_ite_le.statement: theorem hasDerivAt_ite_le (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (c d : ℝ) (hf : HasDerivAt f d c) (hg : HasDerivAt g d c) (he : f c = g c) : HasDerivAt (fun x => if x ≤ c then f x else g x) d c

huber_three_pieces.statement: theorem huber_three_pieces (delta r : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ delta) : huber delta r = if r ≤ -delta then -delta * r - delta ^ 2 / 2 else if r ≤ delta then r ^ 2 / 2 else delta * r - delta ^ 2 / 2

hasDerivAt_join.statement: theorem hasDerivAt_join (f g df dg : ℝ → ℝ) (c x : ℝ) (hf : ∀ r, HasDerivAt f (df r) r) (hg : ∀ r, HasDerivAt g (dg r) r) (he : f c = g c) (hd : df c = dg c) : HasDerivAt (fun r => if r ≤ c then f r else g r) (if x ≤ c then df x else dg x) x

huber_hasDerivAt.statement: theorem huber_hasDerivAt (delta r : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ delta) : HasDerivAt (huber delta) (if r ≤ -delta then -delta else if r ≤ delta then r else delta) r

huber_deriv_clamp.statement: theorem huber_deriv_clamp (delta r : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ delta) : deriv (huber delta) r = max (-delta) (min r delta)

huber_convex.statement: theorem huber_convex (delta : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ delta) : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (huber delta)

huber_deriv_bound.statement: theorem huber_deriv_bound (delta r : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ delta) : |deriv (huber delta) r| ≤ delta

huber_deriv_source.statement: theorem huber_deriv_source (delta r : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ delta) : deriv (huber delta) r = if |r| ≤ delta then r else delta * Real.sign r

huber_linear_hasGradientAt.statement: theorem huber_linear_hasGradientAt (delta y : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ delta) (z x : E) : HasGradientAt (fun w => huber delta (inner ℝ z w - y)) (deriv (huber delta) (inner ℝ z x - y) • z) x

huber_linear_convex.statement: theorem huber_linear_convex (delta y : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ delta) (z : E) : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun w => huber delta (inner ℝ z w - y))

huber_linear_gradient_bound.statement: theorem huber_linear_gradient_bound (delta y : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ delta) (z x : E) : ‖gradient (fun w => huber delta (inner ℝ z w - y)) x‖ ≤ delta * ‖z‖

project_fullSpace.statement: theorem project_fullSpace (x : E) : project (fullSpace : Domain E) x = x

huber_regular.statement: theorem huber_regular (delta y : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ delta) (z : E) : RegularLoss fullSpace (linearLoss delta z y)

huber_step.statement: theorem huber_step (delta y eta : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ delta) (z x : E) : step fullSpace eta (linearLoss delta z y) x = x - eta • ((if |inner ℝ z x - y| ≤ delta then inner ℝ z x - y else delta * Real.sign (inner ℝ z x - y)) • z)

huber_regret_fixed.statement: theorem huber_regret_fixed (delta Z eta : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ delta) (hZ : 0 ≤ Z) (heta : 0 < eta) (z : ℕ → E) (y : ℕ → ℝ) (x0 u : E) (T : ℕ) (hz : ∀ t < T, ‖z t‖ ≤ Z) : regret fullSpace eta (fun t => linearLoss delta (z t) (y t)) x0 u T ≤ ‖x0 - u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * eta) + eta / 2 * ((T : ℝ) * (delta * Z) ^ 2) - ‖iterate fullSpace eta (fun t => linearLoss delta (z t) (y t)) x0 T - u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * eta)

huber_average_bound.statement: theorem huber_average_bound (delta Z : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ delta) (hZ : 0 ≤ Z) (z : ℕ → E) (y : ℕ → ℝ) (x0 u : E) (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) (hz : ∀ t < T, ‖z t‖ ≤ Z) : regret fullSpace (1 / Real.sqrt T) (fun t => linearLoss delta (z t) (y t)) x0 u T / T ≤ (‖x0 - u‖ ^ 2 + (delta * Z) ^ 2) / (2 * Real.sqrt T)

huber_rate_tendsto.statement: theorem huber_rate_tendsto (delta Z : ℝ) (x0 u : E) : Filter.Tendsto (fun T : ℕ => (‖x0 - u‖ ^ 2 + (delta * Z) ^ 2) / (2 * Real.sqrt T)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

huber_average_eventually.statement: theorem huber_average_eventually (delta Z : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ delta) (hZ : 0 ≤ Z) (z : ℕ → E) (y : ℕ → ℝ) (x0 u : E) (hz : ∀ t, ‖z t‖ ≤ Z) (epsilon : ℝ) (he : 0 < epsilon) : ∀ᶠ T : ℕ in Filter.atTop, regret fullSpace (1 / Real.sqrt T) (fun t => linearLoss delta (z t) (y t)) x0 u T / T < epsilon
